reviews.title: Not so great
reviews.text: I’m getting different weather conditions & this one doesn’t seem to be accurate

reviews.title: Misleading
reviews.text: Yet another app that says free with in-app purchases - implying that there is content that is free to use.  What they really mean is you can download it for free, but anything else requires a subscription.

reviews.title: Price isn’t
reviews.text: They charged $19.99 a year after first saying it’s $4.99 a year then the regular price.  App is decent but once they did the switch price thing NO.  That’s totally wrong.  Don’t get it.  Not worth the risk and all.   Sad to that they lied and I took a screen shots of the amounts and still they lied. Not good at all.

reviews.title: This App Hits you Up Constantly-Awful!!
reviews.text: This used to be free and easy.  Now it wants you to donate and upgrade to a paid service every time, and watch a sales video to get the weather. It has gotten so bad, that I deleted it. You can no longer have up to 6-7 cities,you must pay monthly. It is a terrible, money grubbing app that wants to be in your pocket forever…Terrible!
